notes: Each bə-tôḵ is read as a rule 30 fusion giving 'among', headed on the construct noun.

'they shall have inheritance' puts the 'have' on the finite verb, which is what the ASV renders: dropping it leaves the verb with no rendering, so rule 43's subtraction test keeps it there and the unwritten בְ is unrepresented under rule 40.
אִתְּכֶם is the preposition H854 'with', not the object marker (rule 16).
